The robot followed the corridor through its bends and stopped in front of the red wall at the end. I then called `rest`, and it is now crouched with motors off.

The route was not a straight run. Several walls forced detours: a right-hand wall blocked a diagonal attempt, and a dead end sent me back to take a right-hand opening. The final approach went left toward the red wall. Odometry shows the robot ended about 7.1 m forward and 12.3 m to the left of its start, roughly 0.5 m from the wall by the front sonar reading.
